text: I was denied credit from this company, but my objective when applying for credit was to have a credit application drawn up so I may extend my credit to this company. under 12 CFR 1002.7 it states a creditor shall not refuse to grant an individual account to a credit worthy applicant on any prohibited bases. Also 12 CFR 1002 regulation " B '' ( equal credit opportunity act ) is there to promote availability to credit worthy applicants, so they would be in violation. 12 CFR 1002.4 ( D ) states a creditor that provides in writing any disclosures or information required by this part must provide the disclosures in a clear and conspicuous manner. On XX/XX/year>, I applied on an application to B.O.A but their application was not one for use by a natural person, consumer, and original creditor. The federal law for consumer rights protections does not define what a loan is, so I did not want to use that terminology when applying but there were no other accessible forms. I was denied use of my social security card as my credit card when under 15 usc 1602 ( I ) it states any card used to get money, property, labor or services on credit. On my adverse action letter from them it puts that I have major derogatory or delinquencies on my file, but some of those are from closed accounts and debts that were not validated or verified.
